review_independence_note: Role-separated passes shared one orchestration context; they are not claimed as mutually blind or independent review.

implementation.activation_boundary: No operation can activate routing, promote canonical knowledge, or grant target authority.

promotion.rule: Promote only if the exact final branch head passes the unchanged push test workflow, branch is ahead-only of current main, protected evaluator inputs are unchanged, and current main is rechecked immediately before a non-forced fast-forward.

saturation.reason: A new frozen four-gate benchmark and executable failure-localization support layer were added, while real far-domain retrieval under matched routes remains unexecuted.

next_ai.positive: Freeze and build META_N052 using a real-paper far-domain corpus with hidden labels and matched lexical, embedding, domain-stripped relational and graph/structural routes.
next_ai.null: If lexical+embedding retrieval matches richer routes on recall, witness precision, near-miss rejection and cost under the frozen real corpus, keep richer structural retrieval optional.
next_ai.refuted: If four-gate localization misattributes known failures or witness validation rejects valid relation classes, preserve the counterexamples and do not integrate the support layer into active routing.
next_ai.partial_id: If only some relation families admit objective far-domain ground truth, benchmark those families and mark the rest CANNOT_CHECK rather than using post-hoc labels.
next_ai.blocked: If exact final CI, hidden-label integrity, corpus identity or current-main identity cannot be observed, do not promote active behavior and record the blocker.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before promotion, keep the frozen benchmark and rebuild the candidate against the new head without force-updating refs or changing predictions.
